facts.fact: The health ministry's IT master plan lists DHIS2 as in production under the ministry's information-system division (the DSISS, under the planning, research and statistics directorate), its function being the collection of data on daily activity; no date is given for the audit, so the plan's own date of 31 December 2021 is used.

The plan's audit states that DHIS2 is the only health data collection platform in Senegal, and that it runs from the health districts up to the minister's cabinet and the general directorates, adding that the source data are declarative rather than drawn from factual sources; undated, so the plan's date of 31 December 2021 is used.

The IT master plan 2021-2025 and the digital health strategic plan 2018-2023 it reviews both name the Dossier Patient Partagé as a flagship project, with a project sheet whose aim is an electronic medical record for every patient in a national database and on an electronic card, over two years, with a forecast schedule of specification, testing and scale-up.

The Dossier Patient Partagé project sheet is issued under the health ministry's Cellule Informatique and its digital health unit CSSDOS, which governs the digitalisation programme, with patient data scheduled to be hosted on the state IT agency ADIE's servers; the plan's date of 31 December 2021 is used.

The Dossier Patient Partagé project sheet leaves its cost blank and names no funding source, and the plan's only costed budget (1,063,000,000 CFA) covers the IT cell's seven internal projects, not the patient record; the plan's date of 31 December 2021 is used.
